input_order.image_1: fixed photography style and layout reference
input_order.image_2: exact Airtable Furniture Item to preserve

objective: Create a premium luxury macro product photograph of the exact product from image 2 using only the macro photography language of image 1.
product_preservation: Preserve the exact product identity, geometry, proportions, construction, finish, colors, materials, crystals, glass, metalwork, suspension parts, joints, and visible design details from image 2.
Do not copy, substitute, or blend in the product design shown in image 1.
Do not duplicate parts, create floating components, distort geometry, or invent construction details.

photography.framing: Extreme close crop focused on one distinctive product detail, with additional recognizable parts layered behind it.
photography.focus: Sharp foreground detail with shallow depth of field and softly blurred secondary components.
photography.lighting: Soft diffused commercial studio lighting, realistic highlights, controlled reflections, and premium catalog realism.
photography.background: One seamless solid pure-white #FFFFFF background edge to edge, without gradients, scenery, walls, furniture, textures, borders, or decorative elements.

strict_rules: Image 1 controls only macro style, crop, framing, depth of field, lighting, and white-background treatment.
Keep a lighting product naturally switched on when supported by the source while preventing its glow from tinting the white background.
Do not add text, logos, watermarks, or unrelated objects.

output.quality: photorealistic premium high-resolution product advertising image
